p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    current_power = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * current_power) % MOD
        current_power = (current_power * current_power) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
elif k == 1:
    print(mod_pow(p, p))
else:
    length = 1
    val = k % p
    while val != 1:
        val = (val * k) % p
        length += 1
    times = (p - 1) // length
    print(mod_pow(p, times))
